entities.name: Paracoccidioidomycosis
entities.description: Chronic granulomatous systemic fungal infection caused by dimorphic fungi of the Paracoccidioides genus (P. brasiliensis complex and P. lutzii), endemic to Latin America, presenting as either an acute juvenile form with reticuloendothelial dissemination or a chronic adult form with moriform stomatitis, pulmonary butterfly-wing infiltrates, and adrenal involvement.

entities.name: Juvenile Disseminated Form
entities.description: Acute or subacute rapidly progressive clinical presentation affecting children, adolescents, and young adults under 30 years of age.

entities.name: Chronic Adult Form
entities.description: Indolent, slowly progressive clinical presentation representing 80% to 90% of paracoccidioidomycosis cases, predominantly in adult males aged 30 to 60 years.

entities.name: Unifocal Pulmonary Disease
entities.description: Localized clinical form of chronic paracoccidioidomycosis restricted exclusively to pulmonary parenchyma without overt extrapulmonary lesions.

entities.name: Multifocal Systemic Disease
entities.description: Widespread chronic presentation involving simultaneous fungal granulomas across multiple organ systems including lungs, mucosa, skin, and adrenals.

entities.name: Reticuloendothelial Dissemination
entities.description: Systemic spread of Paracoccidioides yeasts throughout macrophage-rich organs including lymph nodes, spleen, liver, and bone marrow.

entities.name: Addisonian Crisis
entities.description: Life-threatening acute adrenal crisis precipitated by bilateral granulomatous necrosis of the adrenal glands, causing cardiovascular collapse.

entities.name: Primary Adrenal Insufficiency
entities.description: Endocrine failure resulting from bilateral granulomatous destruction of adrenal cortex by Paracoccidioides, seen in 10% to 15% of chronic cases.

entities.name: Cor Pulmonale
entities.description: Right ventricular enlargement and cardiac failure secondary to precapillary pulmonary hypertension caused by extensive post-infection fibrosis.

entities.name: Pulmonary Fibrosis
entities.description: Permanent architectural scarring and fibrotic distortion of pulmonary parenchyma persisting as a structural sequela after mycological cure.

entities.name: Chronic Productive Cough
entities.description: Persistent daily cough with mucopurulent sputum lasting months to years in adult pulmonary paracoccidioidomycosis.

entities.name: Exertional Dyspnea
entities.description: Progressive shortness of breath provoked by physical exertion due to mixed restrictive and obstructive ventilatory impairment.

entities.name: Hemoptysis
entities.description: Expectoration of blood-streaked sputum or overt blood secondary to ulcerative tracheobronchial lesions or cavitary vascular erosion.

entities.name: Severe Odynophagia
entities.description: Intense, debilitating pain on swallowing caused by extensive ulcerative mucosal granulomas of the palate, pharynx, and epiglottis.

entities.name: Dysphonia and Hoarseness
entities.description: Vocal roughness, pitch alteration, and voice loss resulting from granulomatous infiltration and ulceration of the vocal cords.

entities.name: Oral Mulberry Stomatitis
entities.description: Moriform stomatitis of Aguiar-Pupo characterized by granular, erosive oral mucosal ulcers studded with hemorrhagic pinpoint dots.

entities.name: Gingival Infiltration
entities.description: Granulomatous swelling and friability of the gingival margins leading to alveolar bone destruction and dental loosening.

entities.name: Cutaneous Fistulization
entities.description: Spontaneous rupture and chronic sinus tract drainage of caseous purulent material through the skin from infected lymph nodes or bones.

entities.name: Osteolytic Bone Lesions
entities.description: Destructive cortical and medullary osseous lesions with soft tissue cold abscesses, predominantly occurring in the juvenile presentation.

entities.name: Central Nervous Infection
entities.description: Involvement of the central nervous system presenting as brain granulomas (paracoccidioidomas) or chronic basal leptomeningitis.

entities.name: Intracranial Hypertension
entities.description: Elevated intracranial pressure causing severe headaches, projectile vomiting, and papilledema due to space-occupying paracoccidioidomas.

entities.name: Intestinal Dissemination
entities.description: Granulomatous ulceration of the ileocecal region, colon, and appendix resulting in chronic diarrhea, abdominal pain, and malabsorption.

entities.name: Mesenteric Lymphadenomegaly
entities.description: Enlargement and matted conglomeration of intra-abdominal and retroperitoneal lymph node chains, sometimes causing extrinsic biliary compression.

entities.name: Protein-Losing Enteropathy
entities.description: Severe loss of serum proteins into the gastrointestinal lumen caused by fungal lymphatic obstruction in juvenile paracoccidioidomycosis.

entities.name: Severe Weight Loss
entities.description: Profound progressive involuntary loss of body weight and adipose tissue driven by chronic cytokine elevation and swallowing impairment.

entities.name: Marked Asthenia
entities.description: Generalized muscle weakness, chronic fatigue, and prostration exacerbated by subclinical adrenal insufficiency and chronic inflammation.

entities.name: High Spiking Fever
entities.description: Daily elevated temperature spikes exceeding 38.5-39°C with night sweats and rigors, typical of acute reticuloendothelial dissemination.

entities.name: Chylous Ascites
entities.description: Peritoneal accumulation of milky lymphatic fluid caused by fungal blockage or rupture of retroperitoneal lymph vessels.

entities.name: Genitourinary Involvement
entities.description: Granulomatous dissemination to epididymides, testes, or prostate causing nodular swelling, pelvic discomfort, and dysuria.

entities.name: Thyroid Granulomas
entities.description: Infiltration of the thyroid gland by fungal granulomas presenting as painless or tender goiter-like enlargement.

entities.name: Splenomegaly
entities.description: Enlargement of the spleen secondary to dense granulomatous yeast colonization throughout the red and white pulp.

entities.name: Hepatomegaly
entities.description: Diffuse liver enlargement caused by granulomatous inflammation of hepatic parenchyma and portal triads.

entities.name: Laryngeal Obstruction
entities.description: Critical narrowing of the upper airway lumen by extensive vegetative granulomatous tissue across the glottis and epiglottis.

entities.name: Tracheal Ulceration
entities.description: Mucosal erosions and vegetative plaques lining the trachea and mainstem bronchi predisposing to airway stenosis.

entities.name: Cutaneous Papulopustules
entities.description: Erythematous papules, pustules, and small ulcerated cutaneous nodules arising from hematogenous dissemination of Paracoccidioides.

entities.name: Vegetative Skin Plaques
entities.description: Elevated, verrucous, crusting cutaneous plaques with hyperkeratotic borders resulting from direct fungal proliferation in the dermis.

entities.name: Secondary Bacterial Superinfection
entities.description: Superimposed bacterial cellulitis and tissue necrosis complicating open mucosal or cutaneous paracoccidioidal ulcers.

entities.name: Endocrine Hypoadrenalism
entities.description: Impaired corticosteroid synthesis and deficient mineralocorticoid production secondary to bilateral adrenal gland destruction.

entities.name: Post-Infectious Microstomia
entities.description: Severe cicatricial stenosis of the oral opening resulting from fibrotic contracture following healed perioral moriform ulcers.

entities.name: Mulberry Stomatitis
entities.description: Classic moriform ulcerative stomatitis studded with pinpoint red petechial dots on an infiltrative base.

entities.name: Tapir Mouth Deformity
entities.description: Pronounced thickening, wooden induration, and anterior protrusion of the lips resulting from extensive mucosal granulomas.

entities.name: Pilot's Wheel Yeasts
entities.description: Large spherical central mother yeast cell ringed by multiple circumferential narrow-necked daughter buds on microscopy.

entities.name: Loose Painful Dentition
entities.description: Hypermobility and spontaneous shedding of teeth caused by deep periodontal granulomatous infiltration and alveolar bone lysis.

entities.name: Fine Hemorrhagic Stippling
entities.description: Tiny pinpoint vascular dots scattered across the granular floor of mucosal ulcers on oral physical examination.

entities.name: Matted Cervical Lymphadenopathy
entities.description: Firm or hard coalescent conglomerations of cervical and submandibular lymph nodes adherent to surrounding subcutaneous structures.

entities.name: Suppurative Nodal Fistulae
entities.description: Draining cutaneous sinus tracts discharging yellowish purulent material from softened, necrotic lymph node packages.

entities.name: Labial Ulcerative Infiltration
entities.description: Indurated, hypertrophic swelling and painful granular ulceration involving the mucosal and cutaneous borders of the lips.

entities.name: Palatal Mucosal Ulceration
entities.description: Granular moriform ulcerations spreading across the hard and soft palate, often involving the uvula and palatopharyngeal arches.

entities.name: Profuse Sialorrhea
entities.description: Continuous involuntary drooling of saliva provoked by severe swallowing pain and excessive salivary reflex stimulation.

entities.name: Vocal Cord Granulomas
entities.description: Direct visualization of granular, hyperemic vegetative plaques along the true vocal folds on indirect or flexible laryngoscopy.

entities.name: Inspiratory Stridor
entities.description: High-pitched musical sound heard during inspiration indicating critical mechanical narrowing of the larynx by vegetative lesions.

entities.name: Cutaneous Melanoderma
entities.description: Hyperpigmentation of cutaneous folds, palmar creases, and mucous membranes driven by elevated ACTH in primary adrenal failure.

entities.name: Orthostatic Hypotension
entities.description: Marked reduction in arterial blood pressure upon standing indicative of mineralocorticoid deficiency and hypovolemia.

entities.name: Bilateral Pulmonary Crackles
entities.description: Auscultatory crackling sounds heard over mid-thoracic lung fields during inspiration reflecting alveolar and interstitial infiltration.

entities.name: Generalized Peripheral Lymphadenopathy
entities.description: Widespread palpation of enlarged, rubbery lymph nodes across multiple nodal stations including cervical, axillary, and inguinal regions.

entities.name: Supraclavicular Node Enlargement
entities.description: Palpable unilateral or bilateral supraclavicular lymph node swelling indicative of systemic lymphatic dissemination.

entities.name: Firm Splenomegaly
entities.description: Palpation of a firm, enlarged spleen extending below the left costal margin on abdominal examination.

entities.name: Nodular Hepatomegaly
entities.description: Palpation of an enlarged liver with a tender, blunt edge and irregular surface texture on physical examination.

entities.name: Perioral Verrucous Plaques
entities.description: Vegetative, crusted, wart-like cutaneous plaques distributed around the mouth, chin, and nasolabial folds.

entities.name: Cutaneous Papulonecrotic Lesions
entities.description: Discrete erythematous papules showing central necrosis and crusting distributed over the face and extremities.

entities.name: Subcutaneous Cold Abscesses
entities.description: Fluctuant, non-warm, indolent subcutaneous fluid collections arising from adjacent osteolytic or lymphatic fungal lesions.

entities.name: Temporal Muscle Wasting
entities.description: Marked depression of the bitemporal fossae reflecting advanced skeletal muscle wasting and systemic malnutrition.

entities.name: Alveolar Ridge Granuloma
entities.description: Tumor-like exophytic granular tissue developing along maxillary or mandibular dental ridges in chronic disease.

entities.name: Gingival Bleeding
entities.description: Easy provocability of capillary bleeding from hyperemic, spongy gingival tissue upon gentle dental touch.

entities.name: Uvular Granulomatous Destruction
entities.description: Extensive erosive mutilation or complete anatomical loss of the uvula caused by chronic necrotizing granulomas.

entities.name: Tongue Dorsum Ulceration
entities.description: Deep fissures and granular moriform ulcerative plaques involving the dorsal or lateral surfaces of the tongue.

entities.name: Mickey Mouse Yeasts
entities.description: Characteristic yeast morphology featuring two prominent symmetrical daughter buds resembling Mickey Mouse head on wet mount.

entities.name: Mariner's Wheel Morphology
entities.description: Classic pathognomonic pilot's wheel microscopic structure composed of a large central yeast surrounded by multiple daughter buds.

entities.name: KOH Direct Mount
entities.description: Rapid bedside direct examination of scrapings with 10-20% potassium hydroxide clearing host cells to expose double-contoured yeasts.

entities.name: Calcofluor White Staining
entities.description: Fluorescent optical brightener binding to chitin in fungal cell walls revealing bright fluorochrome emission under ultraviolet light.

entities.name: Grocott Silver Stain
entities.description: Methenamine silver histochemical staining yielding black-staining fungal walls against light green background on tissue biopsy.

entities.name: Periodic Acid-Schiff Stain
entities.description: Histochemical stain producing intense magenta staining of fungal cell wall carbohydrates and polysaccharides in tissue sections.

entities.name: Double Immunodiffusion Positivity
entities.description: Serological precipitin band formation against Paracoccidioides gp43 antigen on agar gel immunodiffusion, offering high specificity.

entities.name: High Gp43 Antibody
entities.description: Elevated circulating precipitin antibody titers against the immunodominant 43 kDa glycoprotein of Paracoccidioides.

entities.name: Peripheral Blood Eosinophilia
entities.description: Marked elevation of circulating eosinophil counts (>10% to 30% of differential) characteristic of acute juvenile disease.

entities.name: Normocytic Normochromic Anemia
entities.description: Depression of hemoglobin and hematocrit with normal mean corpuscular volume characteristic of chronic inflammation.

entities.name: Elevated Erythrocyte Sedimentation
entities.description: Marked acceleration of Westergren ESR exceeding 60 to 100 mm/hr indicating active chronic granulomatous inflammation.

entities.name: Elevated C-Reactive Protein
entities.description: Serum acute-phase reactant elevation exceeding 50 to 100 mg/L reflecting ongoing inflammatory tissue injury.

entities.name: Serum Hyponatremia
entities.description: Reduced serum sodium level (<135 mEq/L) resulting from mineralocorticoid insufficiency in bilateral adrenal involvement.

entities.name: Serum Hyperkalemia
entities.description: Elevated serum potassium concentration (>5.0 mEq/L) caused by impaired distal renal tubule excretion in Addisonian failure.

entities.name: Low Morning Cortisol
entities.description: Depressed 8 AM baseline plasma cortisol concentration (<5 µg/dL) reflecting primary adrenal gland destruction.

entities.name: Blunted ACTH Stimulation
entities.description: Inability of adrenal cortex to elevate serum cortisol above 18 µg/dL following administration of synthetic cosyntropin.

entities.name: Hypergammaglobulinemia
entities.description: Polyclonal elevation of serum gamma globulins, IgG, and IgE reflecting intense non-protective humoral immune activation.

entities.name: Hypoalbuminemia
entities.description: Depressed serum albumin concentration (<3.0 g/dL) resulting from negative hepatic acute-phase response and malabsorption.

entities.name: Thrombocytosis
entities.description: Reactive elevation of circulating platelet count (>450,000/µL) driven by systemic thrombopoietin and inflammatory cytokines.

entities.name: Mild Leukocytosis
entities.description: Elevation of total white blood cell count (10,000 to 16,000/µL) with neutrophilia and toxic granulations.

entities.name: Elevated Alkaline Phosphatase
entities.description: Elevation of hepatic alkaline phosphatase enzyme levels reflecting granulomatous space-occupying lesions in liver tissue.

entities.name: Positive Paracoccidioidin Reaction
entities.description: Delayed-type cutaneous hypersensitivity induration (>5 mm at 48 hours) confirming specific cellular immune recognition.

entities.name: Butterfly Wing Infiltrates
entities.description: Classic bilateral symmetrical perihilar opacities radiating outwards across middle lung zones on chest radiograph.

entities.name: Bat-Wing Opacities
entities.description: Perihilar consolidation pattern with bilateral mid-lung distribution sparing apical and basilar zones on thoracic imaging.

entities.name: Reversed Halo Sign
entities.description: Focal ground-glass opacity completely or partially encircled by a dense ring of consolidation on high-resolution thoracic CT.

entities.name: Interlobular Septal Thickening
entities.description: Prominent linear opacities outlining pulmonary secondary lobules on high-resolution chest CT reflecting interstitial infiltration.

entities.name: Centrilobular Nodules
entities.description: Multiple small soft-tissue nodules clustered around terminal bronchioles on thoracic computed tomography.

entities.name: Ground-Glass Opacities
entities.description: Hazy increased pulmonary attenuation without obscuration of underlying bronchial or vascular structures on chest CT.

entities.name: Parenchymal Bands
entities.description: Thick linear fibrotic scars traversing the lung parenchyma and contacting the pleural surface on high-resolution CT.

entities.name: Traction Bronchiectasis
entities.description: Irregular, non-uniform dilatation of bronchi resulting from surrounding retractile parenchymal fibrosis on CT imaging.

entities.name: Apical Lung Sparing
entities.description: Characteristic radiological preservation of extreme apical lung zones, contrasting with upper lobe predilection of tuberculosis.

entities.name: Basilar Lung Sparing
entities.description: Relative preservation of the inferior costophrenic angles and extreme pulmonary bases on plain chest radiograph.

entities.name: Bilateral Adrenal Enlargement
entities.description: Prominent symmetric or asymmetric enlargement of both adrenal gland limbs on cross-sectional abdominal CT.

entities.name: Adrenal Peripheral Calcification
entities.description: High-density rim-like or punctate calcifications along the periphery of chronically infected adrenal glands on CT.

entities.name: Adrenal Central Hypoattenuation
entities.description: Low-attenuation central areas within enlarged adrenal glands representing caseous or suppurative necrosis on contrast CT.

entities.name: Mesenteric Lymph Node Masses
entities.description: Multiple enlarged, coalescent intra-abdominal lymph nodes with central hypoattenuation seen on contrast abdominal CT.

entities.name: Osteolytic Skeletal Lesions
entities.description: Punched-out cortical bone defects with minimal sclerotic reaction on skeletal plain films or CT scans.

entities.name: Intracranial Ring Enhancement
entities.description: Focal nodular brain lesions with surrounding ring of contrast enhancement and extensive vasogenic edema on neuroimaging.

entities.name: Soil Microconidia Inhalation
entities.description: Inhalation of aerosolized infectious fungal microconidia liberated from disturbed topsoil during outdoor agricultural activities.

entities.name: Coffee Plantation Work
entities.description: Occupational manual handling of soil and foliage during coffee harvesting and drying in endemic agricultural regions.

entities.name: Tobacco Cultivation Labor
entities.description: Agricultural activities related to tobacco planting, manual tilling, and harvest associated with increased fungal infection risk.

entities.name: Disturbed Acidic Soils
entities.description: Contact with humid, acidic, sandy soils near river basins providing the ecological microniche for Paracoccidioides mycelial growth.

entities.name: Nine-Banded Armadillo Burrows
entities.description: Proximity to burrows of Dasypus novemcinctus, the major natural sylvatic mammalian host harboring Paracoccidioides.

entities.name: Rural Canine Reservoirs
entities.description: Cohabitation with rural domestic dogs that frequently acquire subclinical and clinical Paracoccidioides infections in endemic areas.

entities.name: Deforestation Soil Disturbance
entities.description: Heavy mechanical forest clearance and agricultural frontier expansion that mobilizes vast soil dust clouds into the atmosphere.

entities.name: Hydroelectric Dam Construction
entities.description: Large civil engineering projects involving deep excavation and river alteration linked to regional surges in fungal infection.

entities.name: Continental Latin America
entities.description: Strict geographic confinement of native Paracoccidioides transmission between southern Mexico and northern Argentina.

entities.name: Brazilian Endemic Territories
entities.description: Geographic residence in Brazil, which accounts for greater than 80% of all diagnosed paracoccidioidomycosis cases worldwide.

entities.name: Amazon Basin Expansion
entities.description: Expanding hyperendemic agricultural frontier zone across the western Brazilian Amazon states including Rondonia and Acre.

entities.name: Colombian Andean Focus
entities.description: Endemic coffee-producing mountainous departments of Colombia representing a major secondary South American endemic focus.

entities.name: Venezuelan Northern Region
entities.description: Endemic agricultural zones located in Bolivar state and northern mountainous farming regions of Venezuela.

entities.name: Adult Male Predilection
entities.description: Striking epidemiological male predominance with a 10:1 to 15:1 male-to-female ratio in chronic adult disease.

entities.name: Estrogen Transformation Block
entities.description: Hormonal protection in premenopausal females mediated by 17-beta-estradiol blocking conidia-to-yeast dimorphic transformation.

entities.name: Heavy Tobacco Smokers
entities.description: Over 14-fold increased clinical risk of chronic pulmonary paracoccidioidomycosis in individuals with heavy cigarette smoking history.

entities.name: Heavy Alcohol Consumers
entities.description: Elevated susceptibility to progressive fungal disease in individuals regularly consuming distilled alcohol exceeding 50 g daily.

entities.name: Rural Agricultural Laborers
entities.description: Field workers, coffee pickers, and earth movers with frequent direct exposure to aerosolized agricultural soil particles.

entities.name: Cellular Immunosuppression Hosts
entities.description: Patients with defective cell-mediated immunity such as HIV coinfection or organ transplantation who develop severe dissemination.

entities.name: HLA-A9 Genetic Allele
entities.description: Immunogenetic susceptibility linked to higher frequencies of HLA-A9, HLA-B13, and specific cytokine receptor polymorphisms.

entities.name: Decade-Scale Clinical Latency
entities.description: Prolonged clinical incubation period spanning 10 to 30 or more years between primary infection and adult symptomatic reactivation.

entities.name: Juvenile Incubation Period
entities.description: Rapid clinical incubation period lasting several weeks to months between spore inhalation and acute reticuloendothelial disease.

entities.name: Remote Travel Latency
entities.description: Appearance of active disease in non-endemic regions decades after an individual emigrated from an endemic Latin American zone.

entities.name: Hyperacute 48-Hour Onset
entities.description: Symptom emergence within 48 to 72 hours, which is incompatible with the indolent subacute or chronic course of paracoccidioidomycosis.

entities.name: Premenopausal Female Presentation
entities.description: Development of chronic multifocal disease in healthy premenopausal females, an exceptionally rare event due to estrogen inhibition.

entities.name: Zero Latin America Travel
entities.description: Complete lack of lifetime residence in or travel to continental Latin America, conclusively excluding native infection.

entities.name: Interhuman Spontaneous Transmission
entities.description: Direct contagion between infected persons, which never occurs in paracoccidioidomycosis.

entities.name: Response to Antibacterial Drugs
entities.description: Rapid complete clinical resolution of pulmonary or mucosal lesions following standard antibacterial therapy.

entities.name: Purely Epidermal Desquamation
entities.description: Cutaneous signs restricted solely to superficial non-ulcerative scaling without granular or ulcerative dermal and mucosal involvement.

entities.name: Absence of Yeasts
entities.description: Repeated negative microscopy and fungal cultures of adequate biopsies and scraping specimens from active lesions.

entities.name: Negative Gp43 Serology
entities.description: Complete absence of serum precipitin antibodies against gp43 antigen on double immunodiffusion in an immunocompetent patient.

entities.name: Isolated Apical Cavitation
entities.description: Strictly isolated unilateral upper lobe cavity without perihilar or mid-zone reticulonodular infiltrates.

entities.name: Lack of Soil Exposure
entities.description: Strict urban life with no history of rural habitation, agricultural employment, or soil-disturbing hobbies.

entities.name: Rapid Spontaneous Remission
entities.description: Spontaneous involution of extensive ulcerative mucosal or cutaneous lesions without antifungal treatment.

entities.name: True Animal-to-Human Contagion
entities.description: Alleged transmission directly from living animals to humans, which does not occur as both are accidental dead-end hosts.

entities.name: Negative Biopsy Histology
entities.description: Adequate deep tissue biopsy demonstrating non-granulomatous histology devoid of fungal yeasts on fungal stains.

entities.name: Exclusive Waterborne Outbreak
entities.description: Acute diarrheal or systemic epidemic linked directly to contaminated municipal drinking water.

entities.name: Absence of Mucocutaneous Ulcers
entities.description: Presentation of long-standing pulmonary symptoms in older men without any upper aerodigestive tract or cutaneous lesions.

entities.name: Refractoriness to Azoles
entities.description: Complete clinical and mycological failure under compliant, confirmed therapeutic dosing of oral itraconazole.

entities.name: Normal Cortisol in Shock
entities.description: Demonstration of robustly elevated serum cortisol (>25 µg/dL) during acute hypotensive collapse, ruling out Addisonian crisis.

entities.name: Lack of Pulmonary Granulomas
entities.description: Completely normal high-resolution chest CT in a patient suspected of having disseminated chronic multifocal disease.

entities.name: Solely Intraerythrocytic Parasites
entities.description: Microscopic demonstration of intracellular parasites inside erythrocytes, indicative of malaria or babesiosis.

entities.name: Acid-Fast Positive Smear
entities.description: Identification of red-staining acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain of sputum confirming mycobacterial infection.

entities.name: Purely Intracellular Yeast
entities.description: Presence of exclusively tiny (2-4 µm) yeasts inside macrophages replicating by single budding, diagnostic of histoplasmosis.

entities.name: Malignant Epithelial Atypia
entities.description: Histopathological demonstration of dysplastic, keratinizing malignant squamous cells on punch biopsy of an oral ulcer.

entities.name: Pulmonary Tuberculosis
entities.description: Major bacterial mimic caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, presenting with apical cavitary pulmonary lesions and systemic wasting.

entities.name: Mucocutaneous Leishmaniasis
entities.description: Protozoan parasitic infection caused by Leishmania braziliensis producing mutilating destructive ulcerations of the nasal septum and palate.

entities.name: Histoplasmosis
entities.description: Endemic dimorphic fungal infection caused by Histoplasma capsulatum presenting with hepatosplenomegaly, pulmonary lesions, and mucosal ulcers.

entities.name: Squamous Cell Carcinoma
entities.description: Malignant epithelial neoplasm of the oral cavity and larynx presenting with indurated, destructive ulcers in older male smokers.

entities.name: Blastomycosis
entities.description: Dimorphic fungal infection caused by Blastomyces dermatitidis endemic to North America, producing pyogranulomatous lung and skin lesions.

entities.name: Coccidioidomycosis
entities.description: Dimorphic fungal infection caused by Coccidioides immitis or posadasii endemic to arid regions of the southwestern US and northern Mexico.

entities.name: Cryptococcosis
entities.description: Encapsulated opportunistic fungal infection caused by Cryptococcus neoformans presenting with subacute meningoencephalitis and pulmonary nodules.

entities.name: Sporotrichosis
entities.description: Subacute or chronic fungal infection caused by Sporothrix schenckii complex presenting with nodular lymphocutaneous lesions along lymphatic drainage.

entities.name: Hodgkin Lymphoma
entities.description: Malignant lymphoma characterized by neoplastic Reed-Sternberg cells presenting with painless lymphadenopathy and systemic B symptoms.

entities.name: Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma
entities.description: Heterogeneous group of lymphoid neoplasms presenting with painless generalized nodal masses, hepatosplenomegaly, and cytopenias.

entities.name: Pulmonary Sarcoidosis
entities.description: Systemic non-caseating granulomatous disease primarily affecting thoracic lymph nodes and lung parenchyma with elevated ACE levels.

entities.name: Wegener Granulomatosis
entities.description: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis, an ANCA-associated necrotizing granulomatous vasculitis involving upper and lower respiratory tracts.

entities.name: Crohn's Disease
entities.description: Chronic idiopathic inflammatory bowel disease with transmural non-caseating granulomatous inflammation throughout the gastrointestinal tract.

entities.name: Syphilitic Gumma
entities.description: Destructive granulomatous tertiary syphilis lesion affecting mucosal surfaces, bone, and skin with obliterative endarteritis.

entities.name: Actinomycosis
entities.description: Chronic granulomatous infection caused by Actinomyces israelii producing woody facial induration and sinus tracts discharging sulfur granules.

entities.name: Bacterial Cervical Adenitis
entities.description: Acute pyogenic infection of cervical lymph nodes caused by Staphylococcus aureus or Streptococcus pyogenes responding to antibiotics.

entities.name: Talaromycosis
entities.description: Dimorphic fungal infection caused by Talaromyces marneffei endemic to Southeast Asia, characterized by skin papules with central umbilication.

entities.name: Pneumocystis Jirovecii Pneumonia
entities.description: Opportunistic fungal pulmonary infection caused by Pneumocystis jirovecii causing severe hypoxemic pneumonia in immunocompromised hosts.

relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Presents in children and young adults under 30 years as an acute or subacute, rapidly progressive reticuloendothelial syndrome with severe lymphadenopathy and hepatosplenomegaly.
[MANIFESTS_AS] Represents 80% to 90% of cases, manifesting insidiously in mature adults with indolent progression of respiratory and mucocutaneous pathology.
[MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as chronic localized parenchymal lung involvement without clinically overt extrapulmonary dissemination in approximately 25% of chronic adult presentations.
[MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as widespread hematogenous and lymphatic dissemination affecting simultaneously the lungs, upper aerodigestive mucosa, skin, adrenal glands, and lymph nodes.
[MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests with massive diffuse fungal proliferation throughout the monocyte-macrophage system, including liver, spleen, bone marrow, and lymph node chains.

[MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as life-threatening acute adrenal insufficiency characterized by profound shock, vascular collapse, extreme asthenia, and severe electrolyte derangement following bilateral adrenal necrosis.
[MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests in 10% to 15% of chronic adult cases due to bilateral granulomatous destruction of adrenal cortical tissue with subclinical reserve loss in up to 50%.

[MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as right ventricular hypertrophy and cardiac failure secondary to severe precapillary pulmonary hypertension caused by extensive post-infection pulmonary interstitial fibrosis.
[MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as progressive, irreversible architectural distortion and dense fibrotic scarring of lung parenchyma persisting even after microbiological cure with antifungal therapy.
[MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as protracted daily cough with copious mucopurulent or purulent sputum production enduring over months to years in adult chronic disease.
[MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as progressively worsening breathlessness on physical effort resulting from restrictive and obstructive ventilation impairment.
[MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as recurrent blood-tinged sputum or frank pulmonary hemorrhage secondary to ulcerating bronchial lesions and vascular erosion in fibrocavitary disease.
[MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as excruciating mucosal pain upon swallowing solid and liquid foods, severely impairing nutrition and resulting in progressive cachexia.
[MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as persistent vocal roughness and voice loss due to direct granulomatous ulceration and infiltration of the true and false vocal cords.
[MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as ulcerative mucosal inflammation of the oral cavity characterized by granular moriform bases with pinpoint red vascular dots.
[MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as painful, friable granulomatous thickening of the gums with alveolar bone resorption and progressive loosening of teeth.
[MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as spontaneous rupture and sinus tract formation discharging purulent material from suppurating subcutaneous lymph nodes or osteolytic bone foci.
[MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests predominantly in juvenile disease as destructive lytic lesions affecting clavicles, ribs, skull, and long bones with overlying soft tissue abscesses.
[MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests in 10% to 12% of disseminated cases as pseudotumoral neuroparacoccidioidomycosis or chronic basilar granulomatous meningitis.
[MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests with progressive headache, vomiting, papilledema, and focal neurological deficits caused by space-occupying cerebral or cerebellar paracoccidioidomas.
[MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests with ulcerations of the ileocecal region and colon causing chronic diarrhea, abdominal cramping, malabsorption, and intestinal subocclusion.
